item.title: RDP Protocol Deep Dive: Connection Sequence, Graphics Pipeline, and UDP Transport
item.description: RDP is the most widely deployed remote graphics protocol on the planet, yet the common understanding of it rarely goes beyond “port 3389 and the mstsc client.” Microsoft publishes the full specification set as the MS-RDP family (learn.microsoft.com), and the protocol deserves a careful read: it packs four hard problems — semantic transport, hybrid encoding, multiplexed channels, and security negotiation — into one session design, and many of its trade-offs transfer directly to building your own remoting stack.
